Each finding: SEVERITY [BLOCKER|MAJOR|MINOR] | file:line | what is wrong (evidence from code) | concrete suggested fix. Only report issues you verified in the code — no speculation, no style nits. YOUR ANGLE: correctness, concurrency, and stability of async pipeline code. Focus areas: (1) MessagePipeline send/receive/dispatch loops — signal/wait/reset-pending protocol races (enqueue between IsEmpty check and next wait, lost wakeups), queue drain on dispose, flush TaskCompletionSource completion guarantees; (2) dispose/lifecycle — Session.MarkDisconnected reentrancy, double dispose, channel dispose while a read/write is pending, ObjectDisposedException paths, what happens if Disconnected handler throws; (3) cancellation — TcpConnector connect-cancel race (Dispose-from-registration), pipeline _cts.Token use after _cts.Dispose(); (4) exactly-once guarantees for Disconnected event; (5) TcpListener accept loop error handling; (6) verify the code actually honors the runtime contracts in Feature-Spec.md / Public-API.md '런타임 의미' (faulted Task after disconnect, backpressure async-wait, InlineDispatch default false, handler exception isolation); (7) identify the most dangerous untested paths given Test/Communication.Tests.

I've read the docs, the full commit diff's code, and all tests. I verified the SignalGate wait/signal protocol by interleaving analysis and confirmed the race windows in the dispose paths. Here is the review.

## Review — commit 8159042 (async pipeline correctness/concurrency/stability)

### Verified good first
- SignalGate protocol (`SignalGate.cs:19-59`) is race-free: pending-reset happens before the recheck, and since producer `Enqueue` program-orders before `Signal`'s CAS while `ResetPendingAndResignalIf` uses full fences, no enqueue can be lost; `SemaphoreFullException`/`ObjectDisposedException` are caught. No lost wakeup found.
- Exactly-once `Disconnected` holds: `Session.cs:89` and `MessagePipeline.cs:427-434` both use `Interlocked.Exchange`; `MarkDisconnected` is reentrancy-safe (event fires after flag set, cleanup wrapped in catch-all).
- Faulted-Task-after-disconnect contract honored (`Session.cs:45-60`, `MessagePipeline.cs:143-158`): no synchronous throws; even `_cts.Token` access after `_cts.Dispose()` lands as a faulted Task / caught `ObjectDisposedException` in loops.
- Backpressure async-wait, `InlineDispatch` default `false`, handler exception isolation (queue, inline, and `MessageHandler.cs:47-59` paths) all match the '런타임 의미' section; receive buffer rent/return is in `finally` (`MessagePipeline.cs:296-305`).
- `TcpConnector.cs:27-54` connect-cancel is correct: registration disposes the client, catch-filter + post-await `IsCancellationRequested` recheck cover the success/cancel race; registration disposal waits for the callback.
